case_name: Jatin vs State Of Haryana And Another

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Haryana And Another - wife and state

facts_of_case: Matrimonial discord between the petitioner and respondent No.2, FIR registered under Sections 323, 506, 34 of IPC, compromise recorded in proceedings under Section 13-B of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: The power to quash criminal proceedings under Section 482 of the Code is to be exercised sparingly and with caution.
legal_principles.held: No doubt, under Section 482 of the Code, the High Court has inherent power to quash the criminal proceedings even in those cases which are not compoundable, where the parties have settled the matter between themselves.

legal_principles.principle: The High Court should form an opinion on the ends of justice or to prevent abuse of the process of any court while exercising its power under Section 482.
legal_principles.held: While exercising the power, the High Court is to form an opinion on either of the aforesaid two objectives.

legal_principles.principle: Criminal cases involving heinous and serious offences, such as murder, rape, dacoity, etc., should not be quashed merely on the basis of compromise between the victim and the offender.
legal_principles.held: Such offences are not private in nature and have a serious impact on society. Similarly, for the offences alleged to have been committed under special statute like the Prevention of Corruption Act or the offences committed by public servants while working in that capacity are not to be quashed merely on the basis of compromise between the victim and the offender.

legal_principles.principle: Criminal cases having overwhelmingly and predominantly civil character should be quashed when the parties have resolved their entire disputes among themselves.
legal_principles.held: On the other hand, those criminal cases having overwhelmingly and predominantly civil character, particularly those arising out of commercial transactions or arising out of matrimonial relationships or family disputes should be quashed when the parties have resolved their entire disputes among themselves.

outcome.final_order: Quashing the FIR and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for quashing of FIR
advising on criminal proceedings under IPC
assisting in family law matters under Hindu Marriage Act
